note: atlas-sealocal-8192-1127 (written 2026-11-27, not run): Boundless Atlas docs/031 §16.8.1 item 3, G-682 [Rebase] SeaLocal (pond and sea vertices at * 1, w = 1, sites 0xB60A11 / 0xB60B33) on Atlas main 0.3.20 (asi 7c972767), two arms on the same world and camera path: A SeaLocal=0, B SeaLocal=1, both [Rebase] Enable=1 SeaWindow=0 SeaRange=0 and the atlas-8192-load-thing-8192 setup (AtlasP0thinG_8192.world, menu start). Apex + RTX Remix bridge (Bin state apex). Jobs 1-2 (load-a, load-b): correctness + horizon screenshots past 8191 m from the menu start, then a scratch save AtlasSea-8192-1127. Jobs 3-4 (frames-a, frames-b): frame times. How: profile mode (profile-world.ts) refuses a menu start (it needs live mode at its start: "not in live mode"), and a load_world inside a profile repro would put the load into the window; so the frames jobs load the scratch save the load jobs write (cycle.ts --save) and run a profile window with the same horizon poses plus a camera_sweep; camera-sweep-report.ts gives p50 / p99 / p99.9 / max per segment. Untested: a save of this world has no household (new game, none picked); if the load stops in the household picker the frames jobs fail at load, and the fallback is a household in the scratch save (Rodney's call) or frames-attach.py by hand. TIMING: the B-against-A frame-time comparison (G-681 hypothesis: the wrapped sheets load the bridge's ray tracing) needs a quiet machine and Rodney's OK before it counts; in a normal chain the jobs run as correctness + screenshot jobs. Household rule: the world has no household; nothing here changes a Sim. node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/atlas-sealocal-8192-1127.json Household picker (2026-11-27): the scratch save AtlasSea-8192-1127 has no active household (the generated world has none); the queue load runs cycle.ts, which switches a load that lands outside live mode (household picker / Edit Town) to live mode with enter_live_mode, the same transition load_world LiveMode used when the save was written; the frames repro then proves in_world + LiveModeState within 60 s or FAILs as hollow with that reason.
